newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Press Metal lowers rights issue price.
newsitem.headline: Press Metal lowers rights issue price.

text.p: Aluminium products maker Press Metal Bhd said it is proposing to lower the issue price of a previously-announced rights issue due to a decline in its share price.

In a statement sent to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange late on Monday, Press Metal said it is seeking to revise the rights issue price to 1.40 ringgit a share from 1.65 ringgit "in view of the decline in the prevailing market price of PMB shares".
The rights offer involved between 86.09 million to 121.76 million shares on a five-for-two basis.
Press Metal's share closed at 5.10 ringgit on Monday, just above a year low of 5.05 ringgit. Its year high is 8.30 ringgit.
